cleavage_agent.evidence: The BAG3-FLAG protein bands were cut out and digested with trypsin at 37°C overnight.
Trypsin was specified as a cleavage enzyme allowing up to 2 missing cleavages.

collision_energy.evidence: Peptides were then selected for MS/MS using NCE setting at 28, and the fragments were detected in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 17,500.
